Quick negotiation strategy from Legal/Ops perspective:
- Ask for price at $110k/yr for a 12-month term OR $60k for a 6-month test with automatic conversion at the same rate if volume ramps. Keeps options open.
- Require a data processing addendum with explicit retention limits and deletion timelines for PII-derived fields.
- Insert a 30-day performance SLA credit schedule (e.g., % credit of monthly invoice for SLA misses).
- If TrueData pushes back on SLA, escalate to their VP of Product; they usually move on credits vs. hard SLAs.

Also: run a parallel quick evaluation of ClearLens (we ran a pilot last year) as a fallback. We shouldn't start an RFP, but a 2-vendor bake-off (6 weeks) would give us leverage.

Marcus
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
